strategy.rationale: Official source is a LiveCycle Designer XFA document carrying a complete AcroForm widget shadow; the shadow is filled and the XFA package is deleted so no viewer can select an XFA view and Adobe Reader is never required.

derivedSource.derivation: qpdf --decrypt of the pinned official source (encrypted-pdf-rescue-report.json, 2026-06-17); no content edit
derivedSource.faithfulnessProof: terminal AcroForm field set of the derivative is identical to the official source (81/81 names, verified this session with pypdf against the canonical bundle bytes and pdf-lib against the derivative)

variants.description: One static layout; no finite-variant expansion is required because the widget shadow is filled directly.

legalIntegrityDisposition: Official layout, labels and instructions are the official bytes; only participant and deterministic values are added. Court-use, signature and footer control fields are never populated. Counsel review of field fidelity remains an open launch gate (F-visual-and-field-fidelity).

columnCheck.header: Type of offense (felony, misdemeanor, or infraction)

routeGate.note: Item 7 is Deferred entry of judgment (Pen. Code, s 1203.43). Any other route must leave it blank; the petition is signed under penalty of perjury.

unboundByDecision.printedHeader: Eligible for reduction to misdemeanor under Penal Code, s 17(b) (yes or no)
unboundByDecision.reason: A reduction-eligibility answer is a legal determination about the offense, not a participant-reported fact. Lane E does not assert it; the 17(b)/17(d)(2) columns stay blank until CA legal design supplies the determination rule.

unboundByDecision.printedHeader: Eligible for reduction to infraction under Penal Code, s 17(d)(2) (yes or no)
unboundByDecision.reason: Same. This is the column F2-12b found an offense description bound into: the LiveCycle name Offense1 describes neither its printed header nor its column position.

overflowPolicy.printedInstruction: If additional space is needed for listing offenses, use Attachment to Judicial Council Form (form MC-025).
overflowPolicy.note: The earlier truncate_with_addendum token referenced a nonexistent "Attachment A". The form names MC-025, which this family does not yet emit, so no binding may overflow: bounds are enforced and an over-length value fails the render instead of inventing an attachment.

en.formPurpose: CR-180 is the petition that asks the court to dismiss and set aside your conviction.
en.whatYouDo: Review every entry, sign and date the petition yourself, and file it with the court that handled your case.
en.whatWeDoNotDo: LegalEase does not sign for you, does not decide whether your offense can be reduced, and does not fill in anything the court or clerk must complete.
en.noCheckout: This form is not available for purchase. It is prepared for review only.

es.formPurpose: El CR-180 es la peticion que solicita al tribunal que desestime y anule su condena.
es.whatYouDo: Revise cada dato, firme y feche usted mismo la peticion, y presentela ante el tribunal que atendio su caso.
es.whatWeDoNotDo: LegalEase no firma por usted, no decide si su delito puede reducirse, y no completa nada que deba llenar el tribunal o el secretario.
es.noCheckout: Este formulario no esta disponible para la compra. Se prepara unicamente para revision.
